digest_markdown:
• A single compromised maintainer account turned axios, one of the most widely used JavaScript libraries, into a malware delivery system, affecting 100 million downloads per week. [1]
• Over 454,600 new malicious open-source packages were discovered in 2025, with a 75% increase in the cumulative total of blocked packages compared to the previous year. [1]
• PHP developers accused software supply chain security shop Chainguard of revealing critical bugs in the open-source scripting language ahead of a planned official disclosure. [2]
• A compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 release was published to the Python Package Index (PyPI) and distributed through official container images, allowing an attacker to execute code on servers running PHP. [3]
• The malicious LiteLLM package added files that Python could execute during normal interpreter initialization, targeting authentication material across developer tools, AI applications, cloud environments, browsers, and infrastructure. [3]
